kill_gate.rationale: KILL promoting an extra order_disagreement-augmented deferral scorer into packages/: no strict 5-fold OOF combination of margin + pairwise_order_disagreement / pairwise_order_flipped gains >= +1.5 pp P@80 over calibrated swap-averaged decision_margin on RB2 or improves AURC consistently across both Qwen3.5-4B and Gemma-4-E2B. Swap-averaging (0.5*(p_fwd + (1-p_rev))) already absorbs opposing order conflicts into decision_margin, while OOF Platt / multiclass temperature + existing croq.py handles deferral.

gate.gate_rule: KILL dual-family runtime fusion if precision@80% gain < +2.0 pp over best single calibrated Qwen3.5-4B OR if Base M5 latency ratio > 2.2x for < +2.5 pp gain
REVISE compute_ppi_comparison() default/small-n CI if Sim B empirical 95% coverage < 0.92 at n in (30, 40)
gate.recommendation: PASS at n=30-40 for asymptotic default; bootstrap_t achieves ~95-96% nominal coverage (vs ~92.2-93.5% for asymptotic at n=25-40) and can optionally be chosen when exact small-n calibration is desired.
